messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Vedi | imperative “see / behold” | **കാണുക** | “see / behold” | OK | | la | definite article (feminine) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | bestia | “beast” (object) | **മൃഗത്തെ** | “the beast (ACC)” | OK | | per | causal preposition “because of” | **അതിനാൽ** | “because of / therefore” | OK | | cu' | relative pronoun “which (causal)” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | io | 1st‑person pronoun “I” | **ഞാൻ** | “I” | OK | | mi | reflexive pronoun “myself” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | volsi | “turned (myself)” | **തിരിഞ്ഞു** | “turned” | OK | | aiutami | imperative “help me” | **എന്നെ സഹായിക്കുക** | “help me” | OK | | da | preposition “against / opposite” | — (included in “അവളെതിരെ”) | — | UNNECESSARY | | lei | pronoun “her” | **അവളെ** (part of “അവളെതിരെ”) | “her” | OK | | famoso | adjective “famous” | **പ്രശസ്ത** | “famous” | OK | | saggio | noun “sage / wise one” | **സന്യാസി** | “sage” | OK | | ch'ella | conjunction + pronoun “that she / for she” | **അവൾ** | “she” | OK | | mi (2) | possessive “my” (object of trembling) | **എന്റെ** | “my” | OK | | fa | causative verb “makes” | **കുലുക്കുന്നു** (part of verb phrase) | “makes” | OK | | tremar | infinitive “to tremble” | **കുലുക്കുന്നു** | “tremble” | OK | | le | definite article (feminine plural) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | vene | “veins” | **ശിരകൾ** (as part of “ശിരകളും”) | “veins” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | — (merged in “ശിരകളും നാഡികളും”) | — | UNNECESSARY | | i | definite article (masculine plural) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | polsi | “pulses” | **നാഡികൾ** (as part of “നാഡികളും”) | “pulses” | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `la`, `cu'`, `mi` (reflexive), `da`, `le`, `e`, `i` – articles and certain prepositions/conjunctions are naturally omitted in Malayalam. - **OK**: All content‑bearing words are rendered with appropriate Malayalam equivalents; no missing or wrong lexical items were found.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 88: - Original: ആ മൃഗത്തെ കാണുക അതിനാൽ ഞാൻ തിരിഞ്ഞു; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 89: - Original: അവളെതിരെ എന്നെ സഹായിക്കുക പ്രശസ്ത സന്യാസി, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 90: - Original: അവൾ എന്റെ ശിരകളും നാഡികളും കുലുക്കുന്നു» - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` ആ മൃഗത്തെ കാണുക അതിനാൽ ഞാൻ തിരിഞ്ഞു; അവളെതിരെ എന്നെ സഹായിക്കുക പ്രശസ്ത സന്യാസി, അവൾ എന്റെ ശിരകളും നാഡികളും കുലുക്കുന്നു» ```
